files.README.md:
# Rink game base (Foreman test fixture)

A stand-in for lane E1's engine/templates/rink_game, used by the Foreman's tests and the fake end-to-end proof only.
The real base is hokej made skinnable. The game is `data/game.cartridge.json` (named by `data/match.json` `cartridge`);
the skin is `data/skin.json` (title, teams with name and colour, words).
